verdict.rationale: Letta Code and the CLI/desktop app support rich natural-language slash commands (/remember, /fork, /btw, /init, /doctor) and chat-driven interactions across web, CLI, and desktop, plus agents can be messaged in plain language via Slack integrations and chat.letta.com. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of natural-language command robustness beyond vendor docs, and no benchmark of NL command accuracy.
